title: viscum meyeri
intro: Viscum meyeri, commonly known as Japanese mistletoe, is a hemi-parasitic plant that grows on the branches of other trees, obtaining its nutrients by connecting to the host's vascular system. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to offer health benefits, including immune system support and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Viscum meyeri include its ability to stimulate the body's natural killer cells and enhance the immune response, making it a potential adjunct therapy for cancer treatment. The bioactive constituents of Viscum meyeri include polysaccharides, lectins, and alkaloids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic effects.
